name: Regression Scan
description: Greps test directories for references to SWE-modified classes and methods so the user knows which tests need re-running before a PR.

testRoots.label: Test Roots
testRoots.description: Directory names holding tests, comma-separated. The scan greps these for references to symbols changed this session. Defaults cover common JS/TS/Python/.NET conventions.

fileExtensions.label: File Extensions
fileExtensions.description: File extensions (with leading dot) the scan inspects inside test roots. Narrow it to avoid false matches in fixtures or generated files.

scanSignals.label: Scan Signals
scanSignals.description: Symbol categories the scan looks for: classes, methods, exported-functions, public-types. Disable categories that don't apply to your codebase to cut noise.

runMode.label: Run Mode
runMode.description: How findings are presented. summary (default): groups matches into one table by file. perSymbol: lists every referencing test file per modified symbol.

autoOfferOnSignal.label: Auto-Offer On Signal
autoOfferOnSignal.description: When on, TPM proactively offers the scan after the pre-PR checklist or when the user signals PR readiness. Off requires an explicit request. Default on.

flagThreshold.label: Flag Threshold
flagThreshold.description: Minimum test references a symbol needs to be flagged. Default 1 shows every match; raise it to filter out incidental fixture references.
